vocab.gloss: because; owing to; on account of

example.pinyin: Yīnwèi xià yǔ, wǒ méi qù xuéxiào.
example.gloss: Because it rained, I didn't go to school.

vocab.gloss: again; once more; re-; second; another; then (after sth, and not until then)

example.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zài hē yì bēi chá.
example.gloss: I want to drink another cup of tea.

vocab.gloss: next in sequence; second; the second (day, time etc)

example.hanzi: 這次我要坐捷運去台北。
example.pinyin: Zhè cì wǒ yào zuò jiéyùn qù Táiběi.
example.gloss: This time I'm taking the MRT to Taipei.

vocab.gloss: to know; to become aware of; also pr. [zhī dao]

example.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào tā de míngzì.
Lǎoshī, wǒ yǒu yí ge wèntí.
Zhè shì wǒ de gǒu, tā hěn kě'ài.
example.gloss: This is my dog; it's very cute.

grammar.title: 因為 — giving a reason
grammar.explanation: 因為 introduces the reason for something. In Taiwan Mandarin the 因為 clause usually comes first, and the result follows after a comma. You can also put the 因為 clause at the end of the sentence to answer a 為什麼 question.

examples.hanzi: 因為天氣很熱，我想吃冰。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì hěn rè, wǒ xiǎng chī bīng.
examples.gloss: Because the weather is hot, I want to eat shaved ice.

examples.hanzi: 因為我很忙，今天不能去看電影。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ hěn máng, jīntiān bù néng qù kàn diànyǐng.
examples.gloss: Because I'm busy, I can't go see a movie today.

examples.hanzi: 我沒去上班，因為我頭很痛。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méi qù shàngbān, yīnwèi wǒ tóu hěn tòng.
examples.gloss: I didn't go to work because I had a bad headache.

dialogue.speaker: 客人
dialogue.hanzi: 老闆，我想喝珍珠奶茶。你們的茶好喝嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Lǎobǎn, wǒ xiǎng hē zhēnzhū nǎichá. Nǐmen de chá hǎohē ma?
dialogue.gloss: Boss, I'd like bubble tea. Is your tea good?

dialogue.speaker: 老闆
dialogue.hanzi: 很好喝！因為它是今天新做的。
dialogue.pinyin: Hěn hǎohē! Yīnwèi tā shì jīntiān xīn zuò de.
dialogue.gloss: It's very good! Because it was freshly made today.

dialogue.speaker: 客人
dialogue.hanzi: 那我要一杯冰的，半糖。我還有一個問題，多少錢？
dialogue.pinyin: Nà wǒ yào yì bēi bīng de, bàn táng. Wǒ hái yǒu yí ge wèntí, duōshǎo qián?
dialogue.gloss: Then I'll have an iced one, half sugar. I have one more question: how much is it?

dialogue.speaker: 老闆
dialogue.pinyin: Xièxie, huānyíng xià cì zài lái!
dialogue.gloss: Thank you, come again next time!

sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi xià yǔ, wǒ méi qí jiǎotàchē.
sentences.gloss: Because it rained, I didn't ride my bike.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zài kàn yí cì.
sentences.gloss: I want to watch it one more time.

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào tā de diànhuà ma?
sentences.gloss: Do you know her phone number?

sentences.pinyin: Lǎobǎn, wǒ yǒu yí ge wèntí.
Zhè běn shū hěn hǎokàn, tā shì xīn de.
sentences.gloss: This book is good; it's new.

example.hanzi: 我想去看電影，但是我沒錢。
example.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù kàn diànyǐng, dànshì wǒ méi qián.
example.gloss: I want to go see a movie, but I don't have money.

example.hanzi: 晚上可能會下雨，你帶傘吧。
example.pinyin: Wǎnshàng kěnéng huì xià yǔ, nǐ dài sǎn ba.
example.gloss: It might rain tonight, take an umbrella.

example.hanzi: 電影快開始了，我們快點走。
example.pinyin: Diànyǐng kuài kāishǐ le, wǒmen kuài diǎn zǒu.
example.gloss: The movie is starting soon, let's hurry.

vocab.gloss: to compare; (followed by a noun and adjective) more {adj.} than {noun}; ratio

example.hanzi: 這家店的麵比那家便宜。
example.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de miàn bǐ nà jiā piányí.
example.gloss: This shop's noodles are cheaper than that shop's.

example.hanzi: 昨天太忙了，所以我沒吃晚餐。
example.pinyin: Zuótiān tài máng le, suǒyǐ wǒ méi chī wǎncān.
example.gloss: I was too busy yesterday, so I didn't eat dinner.

grammar.title: Comparison with 比
grammar.pattern: A + 比 + B + 形容詞
grammar.explanation: To say A is more ___ than B, put 比 between the two things and the adjective after B. Do not use 很 before the adjective. You can add 一點 or 多 after the adjective to say "a bit more" or "much more".

examples.gloss: The MRT is faster than the bus.
My older sister is busier than me.

examples.hanzi: 這家的咖啡比那家的甜一點。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā de kāfēi bǐ nà jiā de tián yìdiǎn.
examples.gloss: This shop's coffee is a bit sweeter than that shop's.

grammar.title: 因為…，所以…
grammar.pattern: 因為 + 原因，所以 + 結果
grammar.explanation: 因為 gives the reason and 所以 gives the result. In Chinese both can appear in the same sentence, unlike English "because … so …". You may also drop 因為 and keep only 所以.

examples.hanzi: 因為下大雨，所以我沒去上班。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi xià dàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒ méi qù shàngbān.
examples.gloss: Because it rained hard, I didn't go to work.

examples.hanzi: 因為我沒帶錢，所以我沒買。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ méi dài qián, suǒyǐ wǒ méi mǎi.
examples.gloss: Because I didn't bring money, I didn't buy it.

examples.hanzi: 我頭很痛，所以想早一點睡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tóu hěn tòng, suǒyǐ xiǎng zǎo yìdiǎn shuì.
examples.gloss: My head hurts, so I want to sleep a bit earlier.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 喂，你到了嗎？電影快開始了。
dialogue.pinyin: Wéi, nǐ dào le ma? Diànyǐng kuài kāishǐ le.
dialogue.gloss: Hello, are you here yet? The movie is starting soon.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 我現在騎腳踏車，可能會晚一點到。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài qí jiǎotàchē, kěnéng huì wǎn yìdiǎn dào.
dialogue.gloss: I'm riding my bike now, I might be a bit late.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 搭捷運比騎腳踏車快喔。
dialogue.pinyin: Dā jiéyùn bǐ qí jiǎotàchē kuài ō.
dialogue.gloss: Taking the MRT is faster than riding a bike, you know.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 但是我沒帶悠遊卡，所以我騎車。
dialogue.pinyin: Dànshì wǒ méi dài yōuyóukǎ, suǒyǐ wǒ qí chē.
dialogue.gloss: But I didn't bring my EasyCard, so I'm riding.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 好吧，我先買票，你快一點！
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo ba, wǒ xiān mǎi piào, nǐ kuài yìdiǎn!
dialogue.gloss: OK, I'll buy the tickets first — hurry up!

sentences.gloss: The MRT is faster than the bus.
The movie is about to start.

sentences.pinyin: Tā kěnéng huì wǎn yìdiǎn dào.
sentences.gloss: He might arrive a bit late.

sentences.pinyin: Zuótiān xià dàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒ méi qù shàngbān.
sentences.gloss: It rained hard yesterday, so I didn't go to work.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā de miàn hěn hǎochī, dànshì yǒudiǎn shǎo.
sentences.gloss: This shop's noodles are tasty, but the portion is a bit small.

vocab.gloss: to think that ...; to feel that ...; to feel (uncomfortable etc)

example.hanzi: 我覺得這家店的麵非常好吃。
example.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhè jiā diàn de miàn fēicháng hǎochī.
example.gloss: I think the noodles at this shop are really tasty.

vocab.gloss: towards; to face; to turn towards

example.hanzi: 你向前走，就會看到郵局。
example.pinyin: Nǐ xiàng qián zǒu, jiù huì kàndào yóujú.
example.gloss: Walk straight ahead and you'll see the post office.

vocab.gloss: in the same place; together; with

example.hanzi: 週末我們一起去逛夜市吧！
example.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒmen yìqǐ qù guàng yèshì ba!
example.gloss: Let's go to the night market together this weekend!

vocab.gloss: to hope; a hope; a wish

example.gloss: I hope tomorrow is a sunny day.

example.hanzi: 大家都喜歡喝珍珠奶茶。
example.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu xǐhuān hē zhēnzhū nǎichá.

example.hanzi: 今天非常熱，我想喝冰的。
example.pinyin: Jīntiān fēicháng rè, wǒ xiǎng hē bīng de.
example.gloss: It's really hot today; I want something cold to drink.

grammar.title: 用「覺得」說看法
grammar.pattern: 主語 + 覺得 + 看法
grammar.explanation: 「覺得」用來說自己的想法或感覺，後面直接加一個句子。想問別人的看法，就說「你覺得……嗎？」。也可以在前面加「非常」來加強後面的形容，例如「我覺得這裡非常安靜」。

examples.hanzi: 我覺得坐捷運比騎腳踏車快。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zuò jiéyùn bǐ qí jiǎotàchē kuài.
examples.gloss: I think taking the MRT is faster than riding a bike.

examples.hanzi: 你覺得這個袋子漂亮嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde zhège dàizi piàoliang ma?
examples.gloss: Do you think this bag is pretty?

examples.hanzi: 大家都覺得老闆人很好。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu juéde lǎobǎn rén hěn hǎo.
examples.gloss: Everyone thinks the boss is a nice person.

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.hanzi: 安安，週末我們一起去逛夜市，好嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Ān'ān, zhōumò wǒmen yìqǐ qù guàng yèshì, hǎo ma?
dialogue.gloss: An'an, shall we go to the night market together this weekend?

dialogue.speaker: 安安
dialogue.hanzi: 好啦！我覺得那裡的臭豆腐非常好吃。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo la! Wǒ juéde nàlǐ de chòu dòufǔ fēicháng hǎochī.
dialogue.gloss: Sure! I think the stinky tofu there is really good.

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.hanzi: 我也想喝珍珠奶茶，少糖。我們幾點見？
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ yě xiǎng hē zhēnzhū nǎichá, shǎo táng. Wǒmen jǐ diǎn jiàn?
dialogue.gloss: I also want bubble tea, less sugar. What time shall we meet?

dialogue.speaker: 安安
dialogue.hanzi: 五點，在捷運站前面。出來以後向右邊走就到了。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǔ diǎn, zài jiéyùn zhàn qiánmiàn. Chūlái yǐhòu xiàng yòubiān zǒu jiù dào le.
dialogue.gloss: Five o'clock, in front of the MRT station. After you come out, walk to the right and you're there.

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo, xīwàng nà tiān bú huì xià yǔ.
dialogue.gloss: OK, I hope it won't rain that day.

dialogue.speaker: 安安
dialogue.hanzi: 我也希望！大家一起去，一定很好。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ yě xīwàng! Dàjiā yìqǐ qù, yídìng hěn hǎo.
dialogue.gloss: Me too! If we all go together, it'll definitely be great.

sentences.gloss: I think it's really cold today.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xīwàng nǐ zǎodiǎn huí jiā.
sentences.gloss: I hope you go home a bit earlier.

sentences.pinyin: Xiàng qián zǒu sān fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
sentences.gloss: Walk straight ahead for three minutes and you're there.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de cài fēicháng hǎochī.
sentences.gloss: The food at this restaurant is really tasty.
